scope: Provider fixture font-adoption scroll guard, bounded screenshot readiness diagnostics, and related implementation regressions. Single desktop instance and one bounded screenshot request per fixture.
verdict: No material source defect found. Reviewed source and retained implementation tests are suitable for fresh native verification. Corrected native or hosted acceptance is not established by this review.

source.tested_as: Uncommitted app.rs change on the base commit; all tested tracked bytes independently match the later runtime commit.

confirmed: reveal_provider is initialized for the original provider fixture and has one consumption site. That site now waits for LegacyFonts.ready(), whose existing gate requires font application and a completed subsequent ROOT pass.
Provider readiness still requires the entire password-field rectangle, entire charges-label rectangle, and provider panel top inside the clip. The readiness conjunction is unchanged.
Existing 860 by 670 test geometry, 700 ms screenshot settling condition, 30 second fixture deadline, ROOT screenshot request identity, and GPU copy/readback receipt checks remain unchanged.
All eleven ScreenshotStage variants fit distinct bits zero through ten of the existing u16. New diagnostics are once per stage and remain limited to screenshot mode.
The success-path test now requires the exact eight expected stage bits and checks stability on an additional pass. This preserves error-bit exclusion and finite diagnostics.
The native harness selects named requested, copy_submitted and readback_ready records. The additional readiness stage names do not relax its acceptance.

The provider regression retains visible-content, empty-key, disabled provider-control, and worker I/O-rejection assertions. It adds initial font waiting, preceding catalog-notice reflow, and actual application logic polling.
source_review.headless_test_limit: The regression exercises the embedded-font adoption gate and an added preceding-content notice. It does not reproduce a native platform-font worker result or prove the earlier native timeout mechanism.
